name: Witch Doctor Cauldron/Ingredient effectiveness spellmods work natively (#1273, #2033, #1142, #2869)
contract: All four auras are SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (or, for Fresh Ingredients, the DOT-bonus variant) with MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) or 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT), reaching every target through the shared SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue -> Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers -> Player::ApplySpellMod chain (Player.cpp:10219), which the harness's spell_modifier metric calls directly. #1273 Spice: Earthroot 504424: EffectBasePoints 29 (+30% at DieSides 1), EffectSpellClassMask word2 4224 = 4096 (the 8 cauldron/splash effect spells, represented here by Jungle Shrooms' cauldron heal 802973, SpellFamilyFlags word2 4096) | 128 (the 4 ingredient-toss spells, represented by Ingredient: Jungle Shrooms 801660, SpellFamilyFlags word2 128). #2033 Potion Boss 561072: EffectBasePoints 19 (+20%), EffectSpellClassMask word1 2048 matching Potion Toss 801661 (SpellFamilyFlags word1 526336) and word2 4096 matching the same tossed-ingredient trigger spells as #1273. #1142 Fresh Ingredients 705856/707858: MiscValue 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT), EffectSpellClassMask word1 2097152 matching only Jungle Shrooms' own periodic heal 802973 (SpellFamilyFlags word1 2097152); rank 1 EffectBasePoints 14 (+15%), rank 2 EffectBasePoints 29 (+30%); SPELLMOD_DOT is multiplicative (Player.cpp: totalmul *= CalculatePct(1.0f, 100+value)) rather than additive, still exact for a single active modifier. #2869 Master Mixologist 705864 (an active, non-passive, 2 min cooldown ability, RecoveryTime 120000, that must be cast to apply its 10 sec buff, SpellDuration.dbc row 1 = 10000 ms): effect 0 is the identical Spice: Earthroot classmask (word2 4224) at +100% (EffectBasePoints 99); effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_313 on EffectSpellClassMask word2 1, matching only Spirit in a Bottle 801696 (SpellFamilyFlags word2 1), which Unit::CanCastSpellWhileMoving's generic fallback (Unit.cpp:4627, HasAuraTypeWithAffectMask(SPELL_AURA_313, info)) exempts from the SPELL_FAILED_MOVING check in Spell::CheckCast; Spirit in a Bottle has CastingTimeIndex 16 (1500 ms, non-instant) and InterruptFlags 15 (includes SPELL_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOVEMENT, bit 0x01), so it fails while moving without the aura and completes with it. No module code (modules/mod-ascension-compat) implements any of this; every mechanism is a stock engine path. spell_modifier base 1000 is used throughout because CalculatePct(1000, 100+30/20/15/30/100) all resolve to exact float32 values (1300, 1200, 1150, 1300, 2000) with no rounding ambiguity. Each block unlearns its aura afterward so the four blocks stay independent within one run.
